title: geotargets 0.3.0 (16 April 2025)
text: CRAN release: 2025-05-07 Bugfix @brownag fixes use file.rename() tar_terra_rast(..., preserve_metadata = "zip"), work temporary directory different partition. (#121, PR #122). Fixed examples tar_terra_tiles(), tile_grid(), tar_terra_sds(), tar_terra_sprc() reported @amart90 part rOpenSci review Added details documentation tar_terra_tiles() (suggested @amart90 part rOpenSci review) Completed ropensci review transferred ownership ropensci tar_terra_rast() gains datatype argument tar_stars() gains type argument. default geotargets option "gdal.raster.data.type" (set). Additional arguments ... now passed target “write” method: terra::writeRaster() tar_terra_rast(), terra::writeVector() tar_terra_vect() stars::write_stars() tar_stars() (Thanks @brownag #137, resolves #132 #127) Added tar_terra_vrt() SpatRaster object targets reference multiple data sources (e.g. tiles created tar_terra_tiles()) using GDAL Virtual Dataset (VRT) XML file (Thanks @brownag #138) default driver tar_terra_vect() changed "GPKG" order preserve CRS information (#166). Added preserve_metadata = "gdalraster_sozip" option use gdalraster::addFilesInZip() write multi-file Seek-Optimized ZIP (SOZip) file targets, /vsizip/ GDAL Virtual File System paths reading without extraction (#167)

title: geotargets 0.2.0 (29 November 2024)
text: Created tar_stars() tar_stars_proxy() create stars stars_proxy objects, respectively. Created tar_terra_tiles(), “target factory” splitting raster multiple tiles dynamic branching (#69). Created two helper functions use tar_terra_tiles(): tile_grid(), tile_n(), tile_blocksize() (#69, #86, #87, #89). Created utility function set_window() mostly internal use within tar_terra_tiles(). Removes iteration argument tar_*() functions. iteration now hard-coded "list" since option works (now least). Added description argument tar_*() functions passed tar_target(). Suppressed warning “[rast] skipped sub-datasets” tar_terra_sprc(), misleading context (#92, #104). Requires GDAL 3.1 greater use “ESRI Shapefile” driver tar_terra_vect() (#71, #97) geotargets now requires targets version 1.8.0 higher tar_terra_rast() gains preserve_metadata option set "zip" reads/writes targets zip archives include aux.json “sidecar” files sometimes written terra (#58) terra (>= 1.7.71), withr (>= 3.0.0), zip now required dependencies geotargets (moved Suggests Imports)

title: geotargets 0.1.0 (14 May 2024)
text: Created tar_terra_rast() tar_terra_vect() targets create SpatRaster SpatVector objects, respectively Created tar_terra_sprc() creates SpatRasterCollection object. geotargets_options_get() geotargets_options_set() can used set get options specific geotargets. geotargets now requires targets version 1.7.0 higher fixed bug resources supplied tar_terra_*() ignored (#66)
